title: Saved views in Unified Logs
body_markdown:
## What's new


Unified Logs now supports saved views from the filter sidebar. Click Saved views to open a dedicated Views panel, with built-in presets above your own saved views.


Three built-in presets — Errors, Failed requests, and Database health — are available immediately, even for read-only project members. You can duplicate a preset into your own saved view, but presets themselves can't be renamed, edited, or deleted.


## How to use it


- Click **Saved views** in the filter sidebar to open the Views panel.
- Select a preset or saved view to apply its filters.
- Change a filter after applying a view, and a prompt lets you update the saved view instead of silently discarding your edits.
- Use the **+** button in the Views panel, or **+ New view** in the filter sidebar, to save your current filters as a new view. Rename or delete saved views from the ⋮ menu.


## Why we built this


Finding errors, failed requests, or database health issues usually means rebuilding the same filter combination each time. Built-in presets give you a starting point for these common cases, and saved views let you capture filter combinations your team uses often so you don't have to rebuild them from scratch.
